verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Resolution feature auto-prompts an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) with stack trace/error context to suggest root causes and fixes in a chat interface, but there is no evidence anywhere in the pack of it drafting a code diff and opening a pull request against a connected repo — the GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket integration is described only for source map decoding and deployment tracking, not automated PR creation.
